# Department of Psychology | University of Notre Dame

> The Department of Psychology at the University of Notre Dame offers comprehensive undergraduate and graduate programs in psychology and neuroscience, supported by faculty research in cognitive, clinical, developmental, and quantitative psychology.

Located at Corbett Family Hall, the department serves both academic and community needs through its graduate PhD program, undergraduate BA degrees, and the Psychological Services Center. The department is home to leading research facilities including the Notre Dame Human Neuroimaging Center and multiple research labs investigating brain networks, child development, and clinical applications.

## Key Topics

- Department of Psychology
- Graduate PhD Program
- Undergraduate Programs (BA Psychology, BA Neuroscience and Behavior)

## Community Services & Engagement

- [Psychological Services Center](https://psychology.nd.edu/for-the-community/psychological-services-center): Notre Dame Psychological Services Center offering low-cost therapy and clinical training
- [For the Community](https://psychology.nd.edu/for-the-community): Community services including Psychological Services Center and research participation
- [Participate in Research](https://psychology.nd.edu/for-the-community/participate-in-research): Research participation opportunities including BRAVE Lab and CAM Lab studies
